item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.10.1
item.description: Copy Password now asks for Touch ID or your Mac password before copying, just like showing a password.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.10.0
item.description: Showing a saved password now asks for Touch ID or your Mac password first. Once unlocked, passwords stay visible for 5 minutes and hide again when the Mac sleeps or the screen locks. Inherited passwords can now be shown too.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.9.1
item.description: The update window is now always in English.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.9.0
item.description: Remote desktops run more smoothly: only what changes on screen is redrawn. You can use the Mac's microphone (“Redirect Microphone”) and print to the Mac's printers (“Redirect Printers”) from Windows. Quitting with open sessions now asks first, and ⌘W on a remote desktop is now Windows' Ctrl+W (⇧⌘W closes the tab). New Session › Reconnect All, and plain-text logs of SSH and Telnet sessions (Session › Log Terminal Sessions). SSH tunnels no longer stay open if the app quits unexpectedly.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.8.0
item.description: Sharper remote desktops on Retina screens, with the Windows pointer and sound (when the connection has “Sound: Play on This Mac”). If the network drops, the session reconnects by itself. Pasting large files from Windows shows a progress bar and no longer freezes the app. New Session › Send to Windows menu (Ctrl+Alt+Del, Win+L…), and ⌘Q also signs out of Windows. Faster VNC on slow networks (Tight and ZRLE). Connections with “SSH Tunnel” open through that SSH connection. Full screen hides the sidebar and the inspector, and updates install by themselves.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.7.1
item.description: You can now drag files from other apps to Windows, such as a zip from Safari's or Chrome's downloads or a Mail attachment, not just files from the Finder.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.7.0
item.description: Closing a Remote Desktop tab now also signs out of Windows instead of leaving the session running on the server. You can turn this off in Session › Sign Out of Windows When Closing a Tab.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.6.0
item.description: Drag files or folders from the Finder onto a Windows folder or the Windows desktop and they're copied right there, no ⌘V needed.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.5.1
item.description: Windows no longer shows the shared “Mac” drive when you connect: files move by copy and paste (⌘C and ⌘V). Files you drag onto the session are ready to paste with ⌘V in any Windows folder. The shared folder is still available in the Session menu.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.5.0
item.description: You can now copy and paste files and folders between the Mac and Windows in Remote Desktop sessions: copy in the Finder with ⌘C and paste in Windows with ⌘V, or copy in Windows and paste in the Finder.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.4.0
item.description: Copy files to and from the remote computer in RDP sessions. Drop files onto the remote desktop to send them; on Windows they’re in \\tsclient\Mac. Files you save there from Windows appear in Downloads › MyMRemoteNG (Session › Open Transfer Folder).

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.3.0
item.description: The app is now fully in English. New installer: a DMG that asks you to drag MyMRemoteNG to the Applications folder.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.2.0
item.description: The properties panel on the right shows or hides with the toolbar button (or ⌥⌘I), and the app remembers how you left it. It follows the Mac's light or dark appearance: connection and tab icons turn white in Dark Mode and the terminal changes colors with the theme.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.1.1
item.description: Fixes connecting to Windows remote desktops that require Network Level Authentication (NLA): “Could not connect to the server” no longer appears. Error messages also show the technical code.

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.1.0
item.description: Built-in Remote Desktop (RDP): RDP connections open in a tab of the app, without Windows App. The desktop fits the window, text copy and paste works, it asks for the password if it's missing, and ⌘ acts as Ctrl (⌘C, ⌘V).

item.title: MyMRemoteNG 1.0.0
item.description: First version: mRemoteNG confCons.xml files; SSH, Telnet, Raw, web and VNC/ARD sessions in tabs; RDP through Windows App.
